Tesla proposes paying Elon Musk $1 trillion, sparking debate among shareholders. AI advancements are featured prominently, with Fei-Fei Li expressing pride in her unique approach and a former Meta employee launching a ring using voice notes. In the business sector, Britain faces economic challenges due to a large sickness bill, while an ex-John Lewis boss warns of potential crisis. LED masks face ban for false acne claims. A trader known for predicting financial crises is now betting against tech shares as they decline. In world news, a UPS cargo plane crash in Kentucky kills at least seven people. Lastly, there are reports of African women being tricked into manufacturing Russian drones and concerns about space junk potentially colliding with Chinese crew ships.
